# Third-party material

## Plaits wavetables (Mutable Instruments)

`src/synth/wavetable_plaits.h/.cpp` is generated by `tools/gen_wavetable.py --plaits`
from bank A (waves 0-63) of `plaits/resources.cc` in
https://github.com/pichenettes/eurorack. Each wave is integrated back from
Plaits' stored form, analysed into harmonics, and re-rendered into this project's
7-level mipmap format (the waveform data is the same: round-trip error 4e-14).
Plaits' oscillator code is not used.

## PRA32-U2 (ISGK Instruments)

The band-limited saw tables (`tools/gen_saw_tables.py`, one table per band of
notes) follow PRA32-U2's oscillator design; see that project for its licence.
